SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT SLNO, SRNO, SRNO1, PURNO FROM MRO507 WHERE STCD = 'C' AND IFFLAG = 'T'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KDAC' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,XPLANT + DIV AS PLANT ,PURNO AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,SRNO + SRNO1 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,ITNO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,SLNO AS LEGACY_GR_NO ,'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE ,' ' AS GR_DATE ,AQTY AS GR_QTY ,XUNIT AS UNIT_MEASURE ,XCOST AS UNIT_PRICE FROM MRO507 WHERE SLNO = '$G_RS.SLNO$' AND PURNO = '$G_RS.PURNO$' AND SRNO = '$G_RS.SRNO$' AND SRNO1= '$G_RS.SRNO1$' ORDER BY SLNO, PURNO, SRNO, SRNO1
UPDATE MRO507 SET IFFLAG = 'Y' WHERE SLNO = '$G_RS.SLNO$' AND PURNO = '$G_RS.PURNO$' AND SRNO = '$G_RS.SRNO$' AND SRNO1= '$G_RS.SRNO1$'
